trials.title: Phase II Trial of Chemotherapy in Sporadic and Neurofibromatosis Type 1 Associated High Grade Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors

key_findings: Modest response rate in NF1-associated MPNST (17.9% partial response)

trials.sponsor: Sarcoma Alliance for Research through Collaboration

direct_nf1_doxorubicin.summary: Only one completed trial testing doxorubicin-based chemotherapy specifically in NF1-associated MPNST. Showed modest efficacy (17.9% partial response in NF1 patients) with significant toxicity including secondary AML.

cardioprotection_dexrazoxane.summary: Multiple trials testing dexrazoxane as cardioprotectant for anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity. NCT02584309 specifically addresses whether dexrazoxane reduces doxorubicin efficacy in sarcomas (relevant for MPNST).

cardioprotection_other_agents.summary: Trials testing alternative cardioprotective agents: carvedilol (beta-blocker), telmisartan (ARB), linagliptin (DPP-4i), empagliflozin (SGLT2i). Most are not yet recruiting or pilot studies.

nf1_mek_inhibitor_trials.summary: Phase III trial of selumetinib monotherapy in NF1 plexiform neurofibromas. NCT05253131 tests selumetinib + bromodomain inhibitor + immunotherapy in MPNST, may inform future doxorubicin combinations.

nf1_mpnst_context.summary: Natural history and surveillance studies of MPNST development in NF1. No therapeutic interventions with doxorubicin.

doxorubicin_in_nf1: ONLY ONE COMPLETED TRIAL (NCT00304083, SARC006) directly tested doxorubicin in NF1-associated MPNST
Modest efficacy: 17.9% partial response rate in NF1 patients vs 44.4% in sporadic MPNST
Significant toxicity: febrile neutropenia (12.5%), secondary AML (2.1%)
Doxorubicin cannot be given concurrently with radiation therapy
TOPO2A amplification found in 26% of NF1 patients, may predict response
cardioprotection_strategies: Dexrazoxane is FDA-approved cardioprotectant for anthracyclines
NCT02584309 completed non-inferiority trial testing whether dexrazoxane reduces efficacy in sarcomas
Alternative agents under investigation: ARBs, beta-blockers, SGLT2 inhibitors, DPP-4 inhibitors
combination_therapy_gaps: NO TRIALS found combining doxorubicin with MEK inhibitors (trametinib, selumetinib, cobimetinib)
NO TRIALS found combining doxorubicin with PARP inhibitors (olaparib, rucaparib)
NO TRIALS found combining doxorubicin with NRF2 activators (dimethyl fumarate)
One trial (NCT05253131) testing MEK inhibitor + immunotherapy in MPNST without doxorubicin
research_gaps: Limited clinical trial data for doxorubicin in NF1-associated malignancies
No trials testing targeted therapies to reduce doxorubicin dose/toxicity while maintaining efficacy
No trials testing doxorubicin + cardioprotection specifically in NF1 patients
Poor response rates suggest need for novel combination approaches

for_nf1_patients: Doxorubicin-based chemotherapy (IA/IE regimen) is used in NF1-associated MPNST but with limited efficacy
High risk of cardiotoxicity and secondary malignancies
Need for cardioprotection strategies not yet tested in NF1 population
for_research: Critical gap: no trials testing doxorubicin + MEK inhibitor combinations despite strong biological rationale
Opportunity: test doxorubicin + selumetinib in NF1-associated MPNST
Opportunity: test cardioprotection strategies (dexrazoxane, NRF2 activators) in NF1 patients receiving doxorubicin
